This pack is essentially the "Defected Sound" refined:

Soulful & Groovy: Heavy reliance on organic instrumentation, classic vocal samples, and crisp percussion, represented by artists like Ben Westbeech and Collective.

Tech-House Edge: Producers like Butch and Deetron provide the grit, ensuring the compilation remains viable for "peak-time" moments rather than just warm-up slots.

Cultural Crossover: The inclusion of tracks like "Ripa Na Xulipa" (Franco, LF System) shows the label’s continued commitment to global rhythms and Afro-influenced house music.

[Key Highlights & Essential Tracks]

The Deep Groove: Ben Westbeech – "Deep In Your Soul" is a quintessential soulful house heater that leans into the classic Defected aesthetic.

The Heavy Hitter: Butch – "Official Bump Call" is a standout for tech-house DJs needing a track with a distinct, punchy character.

Vocal Magic: The collaboration between Fiddler, Moodymann, and Dames Brown on "Take Me As I Am" is a masterclass in how to fuse legendary house producers with powerhouse vocal performances.

Modern Classics: Deetron's contributions ("Filter" and "Save") showcase the sophisticated, driving production style that has kept him at the top of the scene for years.

💬 HUMAN PERSPECTIVE / МОИ МЫСЛИ
RU (Мои мысли): Defected в очередной раз доказывают, почему они лидеры жанра. Здесь нет «проходных» треков — каждый из 49 выбран с умом. Сборник идеально сбалансирован: от меланхоличного «соула» до жесткого техно. Отдельное спасибо за присутствие таких профи, как Deetron и Moodymann — их звучание в 2026 году всё так же свежо и узнаваемо. Идеальный пак для подготовки летних фестивальных миксов.

EN (DJ Review): You can always trust a Defected compilation to deliver "DJ-ready" tracks. There’s a specific "swing" in the percussion here that is hard to find elsewhere. Whether you’re spinning a sunset session or a 3 AM warehouse gig, this compilation has at least a dozen tracks that could become your "secret weapon" for the remainder of the summer.
